sections.title: Boston's AI Market: Life Sciences, Finance, and Research
sections.description: Boston's technology and AI market is defined by three intersecting strengths that distinguish it from other major US tech hubs.

items.title: Life Sciences Capital
items.description: Greater Boston is the world's largest biotech cluster — Kendall Square in Cambridge alone contains Genentech, Moderna, Biogen, Pfizer, Sanofi, Novartis, AstraZeneca, and hundreds of biotech startups. The life sciences AI opportunity in Boston is immense: drug discovery analytics, clinical trial AI, healthcare operations, genomics ML, and medical device AI are all active markets.
items.label: Life Sciences

items.title: Financial Services Hub
items.description: Boston is home to major asset managers (Fidelity, State Street, Wellington, Putnam), insurance companies (Liberty Mutual, Hanover), and a significant FinTech ecosystem. Financial services AI — portfolio analytics, risk modeling, insurance AI, and financial document intelligence — is a major ClickMasters market segment in Boston.
items.label: Financial Services

items.title: Research University Ecosystem
items.description: Harvard, MIT, Tufts, Boston University, Northeastern — the concentration of research university AI talent and commercial spinout activity is unmatched globally outside Silicon Valley. This creates a distinctive AI culture in Boston that values technical rigor and innovation simultaneously.
items.label: Research Universities

sections.title: Massachusetts Regulatory Context
sections.description: Boston's regulatory landscape for AI is among the most complex in the US, spanning life sciences, healthcare, financial services, and education.

items.title: HIPAA + Massachusetts Health Privacy
items.description: Massachusetts imposes data protection requirements that in some dimensions exceed HIPAA — the Massachusetts Data Privacy Law and CHIA's health data exchange regulations affect Boston's healthcare AI deployments. ClickMasters designs with Massachusetts-specific health privacy requirements in mind.
items.label: Health Privacy

items.title: FERPA
items.description: For Boston's university and higher education clients — student data used in AI systems for institutional analytics requires FERPA compliance considerations.
items.label: FERPA

items.title: SEC / FINRA
items.description: Financial services AI for Boston's asset management and securities firms requires awareness of SEC and FINRA requirements on algorithmic decision-making, communications surveillance, and model risk management.
items.label: SEC · FINRA

items.title: FDA SaMD
items.description: Boston's MedTech and digital health community produces more FDA-regulated AI software than almost any other US city. ClickMasters designs digital health AI with FDA's AI/ML-based SaMD action plan and qualified regulatory counsel recommendations as standard.
items.label: FDA SaMD
